values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

values.note: 31 sites 'for tent and small trailer use', of which '11 sites can accommodate 30' trailers/vehicles'. The DNR amenity table counts 30 campsites. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsa-m/bigbearlake ('There are 31 sites for tent and small trailer use. 11 sites can accommodate 30' trailers/vehicles', 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (30 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Michigan DNR state forest campground on the sandy north shore of Big Bear Lake among evergreens, 1.5 miles southwest of Vienna Corners via Principal Meridian Road and Little Bear Lake Road (east of Gaylord/Johannesburg). Big Bear Lake Pathway for hiking and mountain biking. Fills up often in summer. This is the main Big Bear Lake campground, distinct from the separate Big Bear Point SFC a mile south. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 31 sites (table says 30), 11 take 30-ft trailers (max_rig_ft 30 confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed, now manual).
